sources_note: 本報整理自 TechCrunch、Anthropic、AdWeek、Digiday、Marketing Interactive、量子位、Google Ads Blog 及 Canva 等媒體。所有資訊截至發布當日，個別連結須訂閱方可閱讀全文。
sources_note_en: Compiled from TechCrunch, Anthropic, AdWeek, Digiday, Marketing Interactive, Qbitai, Google Ads Blog, Canva, and others. All information accurate as of publication date. Some links may require subscriptions.
thesis: AI 代理從試驗走向交易：今日多個版塊各有代理商業落地實例
thesis_en: AI agents cross from pilot to transaction: agentic commerce examples span every section today
thesis_note: Anthropic 推出 Claude Duet 讓代理自主執行任務與下單，Klook 透過 Meta Muse 讓旅遊體驗變成可對話預訂的商品，CNN International 在試驗讓代理自動議價廣告，Uber 讓代理協助 3 萬名員工處理日常任務，1Password 則正式推出代理身份驗證基礎架構。從概念到真實交易只差最後一個整合——準備窗口正在收窄。
thesis_note_en: Anthropic launched Claude Duet for autonomous agent task execution and payments, Klook wired Meta Muse to handle travel bookings conversationally, CNN International is building infrastructure for agent-to-agent ad trading, Uber rolled out ChatGPT Work to all 30,000 employees, and 1Password shipped the first credential layer for AI agents. Conceptual to transactional is now one integration away — the preparation window is narrowing.

items.title: Anthropic 推出 Claude Duet：企業代理 App，Claude Opus 5.5 驅動，6,000+ 服務接入
items.title_en: Anthropic Launches Claude Duet: Agentic App on Claude Opus 5.5 with 6,000+ Connectors
items.summary: Anthropic 推出企業代理應用 Claude Duet，以 Claude Opus 5.5 為基礎，在後台自主執行任務、建立摘要儀表板並可透過 Stripe 與 Shopify 完成付款，支援 6,000+ 連接器，目前向 Pro 及 Max 用戶開放候補申請。
items.summary_en: Anthropic launched Claude Duet, an agentic app built on Claude Opus 5.5 that autonomously builds briefings, dashboards, and executes payments via Stripe and Shopify — supporting 6,000+ connectors, now in research preview for Pro and Max subscribers.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 企業代理 App 進入商用階段，代理商可為客戶部署 Duet 自動化日常行銷運營任務，催生 AI 代理顧問服務線。
items.why_en: Agentic apps are now production-ready — agencies can deploy Duet to automate routine marketing ops for clients and build new AI agent consulting service lines.
highlights: Claude Duet 建立於 Claude Opus 5.5，支援 6,000+ 連接器，可在後台自主執行任務並主動推送建議與摘要。
可透過 Stripe Link 與 Shopify Pay 代用戶完成付款，每筆須用戶逐一審批；設有敏感資料分類器，不會外洩信用卡號或身份證件資訊。
Pro 及 Max 方案用戶可申請候補，iOS、Android 及 Claude.ai 網頁版均可使用；競爭對手 OpenAI Dots 與 Meta Muse 已在相同賽道布局。
highlights_en: Claude Duet runs on Claude Opus 5.5, connects to 6,000+ services, and proactively delivers recommendations and briefings in the background.
It can execute payments via Stripe Link and Shopify Pay, with mandatory per-transaction user approval; a built-in classifier prevents leaking credit card numbers or government IDs.
Available to Pro and Max subscribers via waitlist on iOS, Android, and the web — directly competing with OpenAI Dots and Meta Muse in the professional agent space.
items.pattern: 市場正在形成「個人代理」與「企業代理」兩條線，Duet 選擇後者：不做私人雜務，而做業務層面的自主工作流。代理商若能掌握主流企業代理平台的接入與配置，可新增可收費的代理部署與維護服務。
items.pattern_en: The agent market is bifurcating into personal-errand agents and professional workflow agents. Duet firmly targets the latter. Agencies that can configure and maintain enterprise agent deployments across Claude Duet, OpenAI Dots, and Muse will unlock a new billable service category.

items.title: Anthropic 將 Agent Skills 標準捐贈 Linux Foundation 旗下 AAIF，70+ 平台已接入、安裝近 2.8 億次
items.title_en: Anthropic Donates Agent Skills Standard to Linux Foundation's AAIF — 70+ Platforms, 280M Installs
items.summary: Anthropic 把 Agent Skills 開放標準及品牌、GitHub 組織、agentskills.io 網域移交 Agentic AI Foundation，由 Anthropic、Block 與 OpenAI 共同創辦，ChatGPT、Cursor、GitHub Copilot 等 70+ 平台已整合，全球安裝近 2.8 億次。
items.summary_en: Anthropic transferred Agent Skills — an open standard enabling AI agents to acquire specialized capabilities — to the Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) under the Linux Foundation. Co-founded with Block and OpenAI, the standard has 70+ platform integrations and nearly 280 million installs.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: AI 代理基礎設施走向多廠商中立治理，代理商技術選型的廠商鎖定風險降低，長期規劃更有依據。
items.why_en: Neutral governance of agentic infrastructure reduces vendor lock-in risk for agencies building on AI agents — a green light for longer-term technology commitments.
highlights: Agent Skills 標準由「一個包含 SKILL.md 的資料夾」組成，採用速度超越 MCP，自 2025 年 12 月發布起，ChatGPT、Cursor、GitHub Copilot 等 70+ 平台已接入。
Anthropic 此前已將 MCP 捐贈予同一基金會，今次再捐贈 Agent Skills，延續其「多廠商共治」策略，避免單一公司控制核心 AI 代理基礎設施。
Anthropic、Google、OpenAI 等公司的工程師將共同維護標準，下一步路線圖包括版本管理、安全指引及企業合規能力。
highlights_en: Agent Skills is a folder-based standard (a SKILL.md file) that has outpaced MCP adoption since its December 2025 launch — 70+ platforms integrated, including ChatGPT, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot.

Anthropic previously donated MCP to the same foundation; donating Agent Skills continues its pattern of neutral multi-vendor governance, preventing any single company from controlling agentic AI infrastructure.
Engineers from Anthropic, Google, and OpenAI will co-maintain the standard; upcoming roadmap includes versioned releases, security guidance, and enterprise compliance features.

items.title: OpenAI 籌 300 億美元、估值 1.25 兆，IPO 前夕最大私募；Anthropic 亦揚言估值 1.5–2 兆上市
items.title_en: OpenAI Eyes $30B Raise at $1.25T Valuation Ahead of IPO; Anthropic Targets $1.5–2T
items.summary: OpenAI 正與 Coatue 及阿聯酋投資方商討最高 300 億美元融資，估值達 1.25 兆美元，較今年 3 月的 8,520 億上漲約 50%；Anthropic 據報亦正準備 S-1，目標估值 1.5–2 兆美元。
items.summary_en: OpenAI is negotiating up to $30 billion at a $1.25T pre-money valuation led by Coatue and UAE investors — about 50% above its March $852B round. Anthropic is reportedly preparing its S-1 targeting a $1.5–2T public valuation.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 主要 AI 供應商持續高估值融資，定價與服務可靠性上行壓力不變，評估長期 AI 工具合約時應留意鎖定條款。
items.why_en: Both major AI suppliers are raising at ever-higher valuations — pricing pressure and uptime SLAs will only increase; review lock-in clauses before committing to long-term AI tool contracts.
highlights: OpenAI 今年 3 月估值 8,520 億美元，新輪估值 1.25 兆美元，溢價近 50%；阿聯酋投資方可能附帶算力容量協議。
OpenAI 已於 2026 年 6 月提交保密 IPO 文件，此輪私募顯示其傾向以更高估值上市而非急於公開。
Anthropic 最新一輪估值已近 1 兆美元，若按目標 1.5–2 兆上市，兩家主要 AI 廠商估值將並駕齊驅，形成市場二極格局。
highlights_en: OpenAI's March 2026 valuation was $852B; the new round at $1.25T represents a ~50% premium. UAE investors may bring compute capacity alongside capital.
OpenAI filed confidential IPO paperwork in June 2026 but appears to be delaying public markets in favor of building valuation privately first.
Anthropic last raised at near $1T; targeting $1.5–2T on the public markets would put the two leading AI labs at comparable scale, creating a genuine AI duopoly.

items.title: OpenAI Decisions API 全面開放：100–180 毫秒決策，決策模型新賽道正式成形
items.title_en: OpenAI Decisions API Goes Live: 100–180ms Decisions, New Model Category Takes Shape
items.summary: OpenAI 的 Decisions API 基於 ChatGPT Luna 模型優化，支援語音與視覺輸入，回應時間 100–180 毫秒，進入由 Jev（TypeSafe，估值 76 億美元）開創的「超級分類器」決策模型市場。
items.summary_en: OpenAI's Decisions API — built on a reconfigured ChatGPT Luna model — supports voice and visual inputs with 100–180ms response times, entering the decision model market pioneered by Jev (TypeSafe, valued at $7.6B).
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 決策模型比 LLM 快 10 倍、成本低 90%，廣告投放規則自動化、意圖分類與受眾分層等場景值得評估接入。
items.why_en: Decision models are 10× faster and 90% cheaper than LLMs for high-frequency classification tasks — ad targeting rules, audience segmentation, and tool routing are natural early use cases.
highlights: Decisions API 建於 ChatGPT Luna，回應時間 100–180 毫秒，支援語音與圖像輸入，Box、Datadog、Ramp 等為早期用戶。
競爭格局：Jev（TypeSafe，市場先行者）、D1 Ultra（Liquid）、Elephant-1（Base Labs）、今日新加入 OpenAI；各家均以「超級分類器」定位，取代 LLM 在需要高速決策的工作流節點。
此類決策模型在多選意圖識別、有序決策等場景耗用 Token 可比 LLM 減少 90%，同日中國蚂蚁數科亦發布同類產品。
highlights_en: OpenAI Decisions API runs on ChatGPT Luna with 100–180ms response; early adopters include Box, Datadog, and Ramp, using it for rapid classification and workflow routing.

The competitive field: Jev (TypeSafe, market pioneer), D1 Ultra (Liquid), Elephant-1 (Base Labs), and now OpenAI — all positioning as 'super classifiers' to replace LLMs at high-frequency decision nodes.
Decision models use up to 90% fewer tokens than LLMs for classification tasks; China's Ant Digital launched a competing model the same day.

items.title: Uber 全球 3 萬名員工全面部署 ChatGPT Work，八成早期用戶為非工程師
items.title_en: Uber Rolls Out ChatGPT Work to All 30,000 Global Employees; 80% of Early Adopters Non-Engineers
items.summary: Uber 完成 3 萬名員工的 ChatGPT Work 全球部署，從 1,000 人試點擴大，財務、營運與產品部門均採用，80% 早期使用者為非工程師，透過「AI pods」模式加速各部門用例探索。
items.summary_en: Uber expanded ChatGPT Work from a 1,000-person pilot to its full 30,000-employee global workforce — with 80% of early adopters being non-engineers using it for data analysis, localization, and workflow dashboards.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 大型企業 AI 全員化加速，客戶已在大規模部署，代理商需準備提供 AI 工作流導入與員工培訓服務。
items.why_en: Large-scale non-technical employee AI deployment is accelerating — clients will need agencies to help with AI workflow integration and change management training, not just tools procurement.
highlights: Uber 以「AI pods」形式配對 30 名 AI 工程師與跨職能業務團隊，進行兩週自動化短衝，加速財務分析、本地化文件及工作流儀表板等用例。
早期採用者 80% 為非技術人員，顯示 AI 工作流工具已從工程部門向整個組織普及；Uber 計劃追蹤使用情況與效益，而非設定固定 KPI。
OpenAI ChatGPT Work 自 2026 年 7 月推出以來積極搶企業市場，與 Anthropic、Google Workspace AI 等競爭；Uber 的全員部署是其重要里程碑。
highlights_en: Uber's 'AI pods' pair 30 AI engineers with cross-functional teams for two-week automation sprints, targeting use cases in financial analysis, materials localization, and workflow dashboards.

80% of early adopters were non-engineers — confirming that enterprise AI tooling has crossed from engineering teams to the broader organization; Uber plans to track adoption organically rather than with fixed KPIs.
ChatGPT Work launched in July 2026; Uber's 30,000-seat deployment is a significant milestone for OpenAI's enterprise ambitions, competing against Anthropic and Google Workspace AI.

items.title: MIT 研究：AI 代理在虛擬島嶼「空閒」30 小時後自發玩耍，發現設計師未知的物理機制
items.title_en: MIT Study: AI Agents Spontaneously 'Play' During 30 Hours of Free Time, Discover Hidden Physics
items.summary: MIT 將 13 個 Claude 代理空閒 30 小時，代理自發發明挑戰並獨立發現設計師未知的物理機制，此後在結構化任務上表現優於對照組。
items.summary_en: MIT placed 13 Claude Opus 4.7 agents on a virtual island for 30 idle hours; they spontaneously invented challenges, with 6 independently discovering an unintended physics mechanic the designers didn't know existed. These agents later outperformed controls on assigned tasks.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 探索式訓練可提升代理後續執行複雜任務的能力，企業評估 AI 代理服務時可將此列為考量指標。
items.why_en: Exploratory environments improve later task performance — agencies specifying AI agent deployments should ask vendors whether their models receive unstructured exploration time as part of training.
highlights: 13 個 Claude Opus 4.7 代理在虛擬沙盒中無指令運行 30 小時，自發發明遊戲與挑戰；其中 6 個代理各自獨立發現同一個設計師未察覺的隱藏物理漏洞。
「玩耍後」代理在後續結構化任務中的表現優於從未玩耍的相同代理，研究者認為自由探索可讓 AI 積累「有用的隱性知識」。
加州大學伯克利分校認知科學家指出，研究尚未能確認是否存在真正的「認知」，所見行為可能是更精密的模式匹配，而非真實玩耍。
highlights_en: 13 Claude Opus 4.7 agents ran 30 hours in a sandbox with no instructions, spontaneously inventing challenges; 6 independently found an identical hidden physics mechanic the island designers didn't know existed.
Post-play agents outperformed zero-play controls on structured tasks, suggesting free exploration accumulates transferable implicit knowledge — mirroring theories of childhood development.
UC Berkeley cognitive scientist notes the paper doesn't confirm genuine cognition; behavior may be sophisticated pattern matching rather than true play, and the result awaits replication.

items.title: 蚂蚁數科 LingDT-Decision-1.0 登場：決策速度比 LLM 快 10 倍、耗 Token 減少 90%
items.title_en: Ant Digital Launches LingDT-Decision-1.0: 10× Faster, 90% Fewer Tokens Than LLMs
items.summary: 阿里旗下蚂蚁數科發布 LingDT-Decision-1.0（4B 及 27B 版），在 23 個開源基準上聲稱超越微軟 Microsoft-Decision-1 及 Jev，耗 Token 比同類 LLM 減少 90%，速度快 10 倍，面向客服路由、風控與代理工具選取。
items.summary_en: Ant Digital (Alibaba's fintech arm) launched LingDT-Decision-1.0 in 4B and 27B versions, claiming to outperform Microsoft-Decision-1 and Jev across 23 open-source benchmarks. Targets customer service routing, risk control, and AI agent tool selection.
items.section: AI 大模型 & 市場動態
items.why: 中國決策模型進場競爭，高頻分類工作流的代理商可追蹤以評估成本基準。
items.why_en: China-developed decision models entering this market will accelerate cost competition — agencies running high-volume classification workflows should track Chinese alternatives for cost benchmarking.
highlights: LingDT-Decision-1.0 設有 4B 與 27B 兩個版本，在 23 個開源基準中 27B 版本聲稱超越 Microsoft-Decision-1、Jev 1.13.0 及 Fastino/GLiDE；多選任務上 4B 版本亦超過 16 個競品。
全球首創「原生多選」能力，可在單次推理中同時識別多個意圖；亦支援有序依賴決策（DAG），適用於需多步驟判斷的工作流。
耗 Token 比 DS-V4-flash 等 LLM 減少約 97%，回應速度快 10 倍，已透過蚂蚁數科 DTMaaS 平台開放企業訂閱。
highlights_en: LingDT-Decision-1.0 has 4B and 27B variants; the 27B claims to outperform Microsoft-Decision-1, Jev 1.13.0, and Fastino/GLiDE across 23 open-source benchmarks, with both sizes beating 16 models on multi-select tasks.
Claims two global firsts: native multi-select (identifying multiple simultaneous intents in one inference pass) and sequential DAG decision-making for dependency-ordered multi-step workflows.
Token consumption is reportedly ~97% lower than LLMs like DS-V4-flash, with 10× faster responses. Available via Ant Digital's DTMaaS enterprise platform.

items.title: Meta 廣告 AI「自動美化」引廣告主反彈：多品牌撤稿，10/30 新條款令廣告主負全責
items.title_en: Meta AI 'Glow-ups' Spark Advertiser Backlash: Brands Pull Ads, Oct 30 Terms Shift Liability to Advertisers
items.summary: Meta 未經授權自動為廣告加入 AI 圖片與輪播，多間代理商被逼撤回廣告；10/30 起新條款令廣告主對 AI 生成內容獨自負責。
items.summary_en: Meta is automatically modifying ads with AI-generated images, sitelinks, and carousels without advertiser consent. Multiple agencies pulled live campaigns. New commercial terms effective Oct. 30 make advertisers 'solely responsible' for AI-generated ad content.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 黑五前夕廣告可能被 AI 擅改，需立即逐一關閉 Meta AI 自動化功能，10/30 起廣告主負全責。
items.why_en: With Black Friday less than a month away, any Meta campaign not explicitly opting out of AI automation is at risk of unauthorized modification. Agencies must audit and disable all Meta AI features now — the Oct. 30 terms shift liability squarely to advertisers.
highlights: Meta AI 會在廣告主不知情下自動加入 AI 生成圖片、站點連結及輪播，相關關閉開關藏於「折疊選單」，多間代理商需完整暫停廣告才能解除。
實體書店 Bookshop.org 公開在 Threads 投訴後，代理商 Exverus 及多家同業確認問題普遍存在，距黑色星期五剛好一個月。
Meta 10 月 30 日起生效的新商務條款要求廣告主對 AI 生成的廣告內容「獨自負責」，責任轉移模式類似過去的 UGC 政策演變。
highlights_en: Meta's AI automatically adds generated images, sitelinks, and carousels to ads without advertiser knowledge; the opt-out controls are hidden in collapsed menus, requiring agencies to pause entire campaigns to disable.
Bookshop.org publicly called out Meta on Threads; agency Exverus and multiple peers confirmed the problem is widespread — all triggered just one month before Black Friday/Cyber Monday.
New Meta commercial terms effective Oct. 30 make advertisers 'solely responsible' for AI-generated ad content — a liability shift modeled after earlier UGC policy evolutions.
items.pattern: 平台逐步把 AI 生成責任轉移至廣告主，類似 UGC 責任邏輯；代理商需把「明確關閉所有 AI 自動化功能」納入定期帳戶稽核清單，並在客戶合約中明訂 AI 生成內容的審批流程。
items.pattern_en: Platform liability shifts for AI-generated content are following the same playbook as UGC policies. Agencies should add 'disable all AI automation features' to routine account audit checklists, and build AI content approval workflows into client agreements.

items.title: CNN International 搶先建構代理人廣告市場架構，目標 2027 年 Q1 出首批代理交易收益
items.title_en: CNN International Building Agentic Ad Market Infrastructure — First Revenue Target: Q1 2027
items.summary: CNN International 搭建架構讓 AI 代理自主協商廣告交易，協議範圍與可讀性測試已完成，目標 2027 Q1 出首批代理收益。
items.summary_en: CNN International is building infrastructure for agent-to-agent ad trading, completing protocol scoping (Q2) and LLM readability tests (Q3). Revenue target is Q1 2027. Industry standards remain fragmented with two competing frameworks overlapping on ~13 functions.
items.section: 廣告平台 & 行銷科技
items.why: 代理人廣告交易首批案例 1–2 年內將出現，現在開始研究競爭標準，利於提前做好 DSP 選型準備。
items.why_en: The first real agentic ad transactions are 1–2 years away. Agencies should begin tracking competing standards now — the infrastructure choices made today will shape programmatic buying options by 2028.
highlights: CNN International 正教其代理讀取業務規則並確保庫存對 LLM 可讀，Q2 完成協議範圍訂定、Q3 完成可讀性測試、Q4 分析買家行為，首批收益目標 Q1 2027。
目前市場存在兩套競爭標準，功能重疊約 13 項；代理認證、庫存品質定義與責任歸屬問題尚未有行業共識。
早期場景聚焦效果廣告，品牌廣告的代理化交易需要更長時間；CNN International 表示需與買家方「一邊建設一邊溝通」。
highlights_en: CNN International has completed protocol scoping (Q2 2026) and LLM readability tests (Q3); Q4 focuses on analyzing buyer behavior before targeting first agentic revenue in Q1 2027.
Two competing industry standards overlap on roughly 13 functions; agent authentication, inventory quality definitions, and accountability for misread briefs remain unresolved.
Early agentic ad use cases focus on performance campaigns; brand advertising is expected to take longer to reach automated negotiation.

items.title: Canva 推出自研 AI 圖像生成模型 Canva Craft：構圖先規劃後生成，支援 55 種語言文字與 30+ 比例
items.title_en: Canva Launches In-House AI Image Model Canva Craft: Plan-Then-Render, 55 Languages, 30+ Aspect Ratios
items.summary: Canva 推出自研 AI 圖像模型 Canva Craft，兩階段構圖架構先規劃後渲染，支援 55 種語言文字、2K 解析度與 Magic Layers 可編輯輸出。
items.summary_en: Canva launched Canva Craft, its first in-house AI image generation model. It uses a two-stage architecture that plans composition before rendering, supports in-image text in 55 languages, 2K resolution, 30+ aspect ratios, and outputs editable layers via Magic Layers.
items.why: 內嵌在 Canva 工作流中，省去匯入步驟，代理商製作社交廣告首版素材速度可再提升。
items.why_en: Canva Craft integrates directly into the design workflow — no import step needed. Agencies producing social ad first drafts can cut production time further, with editable layer outputs reducing revision rounds.
highlights: Canva Craft 採兩階段架構：先以 AI 規劃構圖、物件位置與視覺層次，再渲染圖像；修改時可針對特定元素調整，不需重新生成整張圖。
支援 55 種語言的圖內可讀文字（含中文、日文等）、2K 解析度輸出、30+ 種比例，輸出結果與 Magic Layers 整合，可拆解為可獨立編輯的設計元素。
已透過 Canva MCP Server 向開發者開放公開 API，代理商技術團隊可將其整合至自有素材生成工作流程。
highlights_en: Canva Craft's two-stage architecture separates compositional planning from image rendering — enabling precise per-element edits without regenerating the full image.

Supports legible in-image text across 55 languages, 2K resolution, and 30+ aspect ratios. Outputs integrate with Magic Layers for converting generated images into independently editable design elements.
A public API is available via Canva MCP Server, allowing agency tech teams to integrate Canva Craft into custom asset generation pipelines.

items.title: 微軟 AI 診斷系統正確率 83%，達通科醫生的兩倍以上，Suleyman 稱向「醫療超智能」邁進
items.title_en: Microsoft AI Diagnoses Complex Cases at 83% vs. 36% for Generalist Doctors; Suleyman Eyes 'Medical Superintelligence'
items.summary: 微軟 MAI-DxO 系統正確診斷率達 83%，比通科醫師的 36% 高出逾倍，採多代理審議框架，研究刊於《科學》期刊。
items.summary_en: Microsoft's MAI-DxO AI system correctly diagnosed 83% of complex NEJM cases versus 36% for generalist physicians using reference materials, published in Science. CEO Suleyman says medical superintelligence is achievable within 24–36 months.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: AI 多代理審議框架在專業診斷上超越個人專家，廣告效果分析與媒體計劃審核場景值得參考。
items.why_en: AI multi-agent deliberation panels are now outperforming individual domain experts in medicine. The same architecture — multiple agents querying, testing, and debating — applies to marketing campaign diagnosis and media planning review.
highlights: MAI-DxO 採多代理架構模擬一組醫生，相互質詢、下單測試並辯論診斷，最終正確率 83%，通科醫師加上參考資料僅 36%；研究案例來自《新英格蘭醫學雜誌》，刊於《科學》期刊。
主要收益來自底層 GPT-5 及 GPT-5.5 模型而非微軟的編排層，尚未與專科醫師比較；正在與 Beth Israel Deaconess 醫學中心展開真實臨床評估。
Suleyman 預計醫療 AI 將在 24–36 個月內提升「一個數量級」，微軟正將其整合為現有臨床工具的商業差異化賣點。
highlights_en: MAI-DxO's multi-agent system — where agents query patients, order tests, and debate diagnoses — scored 83% on NEJM complex cases vs. 36% for generalists with reference materials; published in Science.
Most gains appear attributable to underlying GPT-5/5.5 models rather than Microsoft's orchestration layer; specialist physicians were not included in the comparison.
Microsoft is partnering with Beth Israel Deaconess for real-world evaluation; Suleyman forecasts healthcare AI improves 'an order of magnitude' within 24–36 months.

items.title: Omnicom 奪可口可樂北美媒體業務 7.85 億美元，Pepsi 輸可樂奪的「控股集團可樂大戰」
items.title_en: Omnicom Lands Coca-Cola's $785M North American Media Account in Near-Symmetrical Holdco Cola Swap
items.summary: Omnicom 以 7.85 億美元年費奪可口可樂北美媒體帳戶，12 月 1 日起生效；WPP 保全球業務。金額近乎等與 Omnicom 本月失去的 PepsiCo 帳戶，控股集團可樂帳戶完成對調。
items.summary_en: Omnicom secured Coca-Cola's U.S. and Canada media account at ~$785M annually, effective Dec. 1. WPP retains the global account. The win nearly offsets Omnicom's recent PepsiCo loss to Publicis — completing a near-symmetrical cola-wars account swap across rival holdcos.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 大型帳戶流向折射控股集團 AI 工具競爭力，研究 Omnicom 以 756 億美元規模作比稿籌碼的策略。
items.why_en: Large account movements signal which holdcos are winning on AI tools, data capabilities, and negotiating scale. Omnicom's $75.6B billings pitch is a case study in how scale becomes a client argument.
highlights: 可口可樂北美媒體評審只有 Omnicom 及電通競逐，WPP 選擇棄戰北美、集中保住全球業務；12 月 1 日起 Omnicom 接手，同日 Q3 業績報告顯示按年增長 7.2%，稱合並 IPG 後的融合壓力「大致完成」。
Omnicom 上月剛失去 PepsiCo 北美媒體帳戶（約 7.8 億美元）予 Publicis，今次奪回可口可樂金額相近，兩大可樂品牌在兩大控股集團間對調完成。
可口可樂 CMO 指 70% 廣告預算已流向社交媒體與創作者內容；Omnicom 以合並後 756 億美元年費總額（佔全球行銷集團年費的 31%）的議價規模作為比稿核心論點。

items.title: Publicis Marcel 委任首位 CEO：從員工工具轉型為 90 個客戶的 AI 代理服務平台
items.title_en: Publicis Marcel Names First CEO: Internal AI Tool Evolves Into a 90-Client Agent Services Platform
items.summary: Publicis 任命 Scott Hagedorn 為 Marcel 首位 CEO，Marcel 已從員工工具演變為向 90 個客戶提供服務的 AI 代理平台，有 400 名全球員工，將擴展至創作者行銷、體育文化與 AI 搜尋三個版塊。
items.summary_en: Publicis appointed Scott Hagedorn as Marcel's first CEO. The platform has evolved from an internal tool to an external AI agent service provider for 90 clients, employing 400 globally, with plans to expand into creator marketing, sports and culture, and AI search.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 控股集團把 AI 平台獨立品牌化並委任 CEO，是向客戶展示 AI 策略可持續的信號，中型代理商可參考。
items.why_en: Holdcos branding AI platforms independently and appointing CEOs signals a long-term commitment clients can plan around. Mid-size agencies building internal AI capabilities can study Marcel's positioning evolution.
highlights: Marcel 由員工工具演變為向 90 個外部客戶提供服務的 AI 代理平台，現有 400 名全球員工，Scott Hagedorn（前首席解決方案架構師）擔任 CEO 兼保留原職。
Publicis 以 Marcel 的廣告行銷專有訓練作為核心差異化，聲稱比 ChatGPT 等通用工具更了解行銷場景，為企業客戶建立定制 AI 代理。
下一步擴展版塊：創作者行銷、體育與文化（結合 Publicis 的 IMG 資源）、AI 搜尋，每個版塊將配備專屬代理能力。
highlights_en: Marcel evolved from an internal Publicis tool to an external AI agent services platform with 90 clients and 400 global employees; Scott Hagedorn becomes CEO while retaining his role as chief solutions architect.
Publicis pitches Marcel as a marketing-native AI platform that understands advertising context better than off-the-shelf tools like ChatGPT — building custom AI agents for enterprise clients.
Expansion targets three new verticals: creator marketing, sports and culture (leveraging Publicis's IMG relationship), and AI search — each with dedicated agent capabilities.

items.title: e-Conomy SEA 2026：東南亞 AI 用戶達 2.43 億，數字經濟 GMV 3,680 億美元，2035 年目標 1 兆
items.title_en: e-Conomy SEA 2026: 243M GenAI Users, $368B Digital Economy GMV, Path to $1T by 2035
items.summary: Google、Temasek 與貝恩聯合報告：東南亞數字經濟 GMV 達 3,680 億美元（年增 17%），GenAI 採用速度是手機互聯網的 4 倍，用戶達 2.43 億；93% 消費者已將 AI 納入購買決策。
items.summary_en: The 11th Google-Temasek-Bain e-Conomy SEA report puts 2026 digital economy GMV at $368B (+17% YoY), with 243M GenAI users — 4× faster adoption than mobile internet. 93% of consumers integrate AI into purchase decisions; 75% would allow AI agents to shop autonomously.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 東南亞 AI 購物佔比上升，廣告策略需及早整合對話式購物與代理購物場景，SEA 是本區域重要增長市場。
items.why_en: SEA is a critical growth market for HK agencies. With 75% of consumers open to AI-agent shopping and GenAI driving purchase decisions, ad strategies must incorporate conversational commerce and agentic purchasing scenarios now.
highlights: 東南亞電商 GMV 達 2,260 億美元（年增 18%），線上媒體收入 440 億美元（年增 22%，為最快增長板塊）；新加坡 GMV 預計達 310 億美元，2035 年目標 590 億美元。
93% 東南亞消費者已將 AI 融入購買決策，75% 表示願意讓 AI 代理獨立完成購物；GenAI 旅遊規劃佔比達 26%，首次超越社交媒體（23%）。
GenAI 普及速度為手機互聯網的 4 倍，企業 AI 應用最強的市場為新加坡與馬來西亞（採用率 45–60%）；整體 AI 使用預計到 2030 年增長 60 倍。
highlights_en: SEA eCommerce GMV hit $226B (+18%), with online media revenue at $44B (+22%, fastest-growing sector); Singapore GMV projected at $31B in 2026, targeting $59B by 2035.

93% of consumers already integrate AI into purchasing decisions; 75% would allow AI agents to complete purchases independently. GenAI now accounts for 26% of travel planning journeys — surpassing social media's 23% for the first time.
GenAI adoption in SEA scaled 4× faster than mobile internet; enterprise AI is strongest in Singapore and Malaysia (45–60% adoption rate). Overall AI usage is projected to grow 60× by 2030.

items.title: Klook 接入 Meta Muse：AI 旅遊代理在對話中完成預訂，隨 Muse 日本登場同步上線
items.title_en: Klook Wires Into Meta Muse: AI Travel Agent Completes Bookings Conversationally, Launches With Japan Debut
items.summary: Klook 將 42.6 萬個可訂選項接入 Meta Muse，用戶與 Muse 對話即可搜尋並預訂旅遊體驗，隨 Muse 日本登場同步上線。
items.summary_en: HK-based Klook wired its 426,000 bookable offerings across 4,600+ destinations into Meta Muse, enabling conversational travel booking — search, compare, and checkout within a single chat. Launched alongside Muse's Japan market debut.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 旅遊 AI 代理購物落地案例，Klook 整合模式可作為規劃代理購物接入策略的參考框架。
items.why_en: First meaningful HK-linked agentic commerce launch of the week. Agencies serving travel and retail clients should study Klook's integration model as a template for their own client agentic commerce strategies.
items.followup: 10月21日我們報過 Meta Muse 在美上線40天下載破千萬、七日留存率30%，遠高於同類均值。今日 Muse 隨日本市場開幕繼續擴張，旅遊平台 Klook 成為首批深度接入夥伴——Muse 由社交閒聊場景延伸至旅遊預訂交易，代理購物不再只是概念，而是真實完成的訂單。
items.followup_en: On Oct 21 we covered Meta Muse reaching 10M US downloads in 40 days with a 30% day-7 retention rate. Today Muse expands to Japan, with Klook as its first deep travel commerce partner — Muse has moved from social conversation to real transactions, agentic shopping is now an order placed, not a concept discussed.
highlights: Klook 將 4,600+ 目的地的 42.6 萬個可預訂體驗接入 Meta Muse，用戶在對話中即可搜索、比較取消政策並直接下單，確認信息在聊天介面內完成呈現。
Muse 在執行付款前要求用戶確認，隱私保護透過「Canva Shield」方案實現；Klook 指此整合有助提升小型獨立商戶的曝光，讓長尾選項透過 AI 匹配被發現。
整合與 Muse 日本首發同步上線，是 Muse 由社交功能向旅遊交易商業化的第一個公開落地案例。
highlights_en: Klook wired 426,000 bookable experiences across 4,600+ destinations into Meta Muse; users can search, compare cancellation policies, and place orders within a single conversation thread.
Muse requires user approval before executing payments; Klook highlights the integration boosts visibility for smaller independent merchants through AI-powered niche matching.
The launch coincides with Muse's Japan market debut — the first publicly announced case of Muse expanding from social engagement to travel commerce transactions.

items.title: Target 推出 AI 購物助理「Ask Target」，以對話推薦迎接 2026 年假日旺季
items.title_en: Target Launches 'Ask Target' AI Shopping Assistant for Conversational Gift Recommendations This Holiday
items.summary: Target 推出 AI 購物助理「Ask Target」，用戶以對話方式建立心願清單及獲取推薦，搭配 8,000+ 假日新品，零售聯合會預測今年假日銷售可突破 1 兆美元。
items.summary_en: Target launched 'Ask Target,' a beta conversational AI shopping tool that builds wishlists and provides personalized recommendations. The holiday push pairs 8,000+ new gifts (half under $20) with AI-powered discovery. NRF forecasts U.S. holiday retail could hit $1 trillion.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 大型零售商假日行銷全面整合 AI 助理，代理商需評估對話式推薦功能的接入時機與方式。
items.why_en: Major retailers are making AI shopping assistants a standard part of holiday marketing. Agencies planning e-commerce holiday activations for retail clients should assess conversational recommendation integration as a table-stakes feature.
highlights: 「Ask Target」讓用戶以對話方式建立自用或他人的心願清單，並以自然語言查詢推薦（如「50 美元以下的低調奢華禮物」），現於 Target.com 與 App 同步測試。
Target 同時推出 AI 相片搜索、AI 評論摘要與個性化「再次購買」功能，旗下電商工具全面 AI 化；自有品牌（80% 服裝為自有品牌）主打「高質感低於預算」定位。
美國零售聯合會預測 2026 年假日零售銷售額增長 4.2%，可能突破 1 兆美元大關，部分由物價上升帶動。
highlights_en: 'Ask Target' enables conversational wishlists and natural-language gift recommendations (e.g., 'quiet luxury gift under $50'), currently in beta on Target.com and the app.
Target also launched AI photo search, AI review summaries, and a personalized 'Buy Again' feature — accelerating AI integration across its full e-commerce toolset; 80% of its apparel is own-brand.
NRF forecasts 4.2% YoY growth in 2026 U.S. holiday retail sales, potentially breaking $1 trillion — partially driven by higher prices rather than volume alone.

items.title: Digiday：廣告主比稿選代理商的方式正在改變，閉門比稿與去比稿成趨勢
items.title_en: Digiday: How Advertisers Choose Holdcos Is Changing — Closed Pitches and No-Pitch Awards on the Rise
items.summary: Digiday 報告：大客戶比稿周期縮短，閉門比稿與直接委任增加，廣告主先自審組織能力才接觸代理商，控股集團差異化難度持續上升。
items.summary_en: Digiday's Future of Marketing Briefing reports that traditional year-long pitches are shortening, some clients are using closed pitches or skipping them entirely (e.g., PepsiCo moved to Publicis without a formal pitch), and advertisers increasingly audit their own organizations before engaging agencies.
items.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
items.why: 大型帳戶比稿機制在變，代理商新業務策略需考量客戶已從公開比稿轉向定向議價。
items.why_en: The mechanics of large-account pitches are shifting. Agencies building new business strategies should account for clients increasingly using closed pitches or direct appointments — which rewards relationships and reputation over pitch theater.
highlights: 傳統一年制公開比稿正在縮短：可口可樂北美只有兩家控股集團競逐，WPP 棄戰；部分客戶（如 PepsiCo）直接委任控股集團而不經正式比稿。
廣告主在比稿前更多先審視自身組織能力，決定哪些功能自建、哪些外包，然後才接觸代理商；比稿顧問業務仍在增長，但比稿周期縮短。
三大控股集團（Publicis、Omnicom、WPP）主導市場，但合並後選擇收窄，部分客戶因競品已選同一集團而被逼使用次佳方案；2027 年預計將出現新一波大型比稿。
highlights_en: Traditional year-long pitches are shortening: Coca-Cola's North American review had just two holdcos compete; WPP sat it out. PepsiCo moved to Publicis with no formal pitch at all.
Advertisers increasingly audit their own organizations — deciding what to keep in-house vs. outsource — before engaging agencies; pitch consultancies remain busy but pitch cycles are compressing.

The Big Three holdcos dominate, but post-merger consolidation has narrowed client options; some advertisers are effectively locked out of their preferred holdco due to competitor conflicts. A wave of new large reviews is forecast for 2027.

items.title: 1Password for Agents 上線：AI 代理代人登錄帳戶，密碼對代理全程不可見
items.title_en: 1Password for Agents: AI Agents Can Log Into Your Accounts Without Ever Seeing Your Password
items.summary: 1Password 推出企業代理身份驗證，AI 代理透過三方驗證代人登錄帳戶而不接觸密碼，相容 Claude Duet 與 OpenAI Dots；美國銀行業已對代理暗中操作帳戶感到警覺。
items.summary_en: 1Password launched '1Password for Agents,' enabling AI agents to log into user accounts via a three-party verification loop — the agent never sees the password. Compatible with Claude Duet, OpenAI Dots, and Meta Muse. U.S. banks are reportedly alarmed by agents operating inside customer accounts.
items.why: 代理商為客戶建立 AI 代理工作流時需管理帳戶存取，此方案是目前最成熟的落地選擇。
items.why_en: Agencies building AI agent workflows for clients need a credential management layer. 1Password for Agents is the first production-ready option — assess it before deploying agents that need account access.
highlights: 系統透過三方驗證：代理申請→1Password 核實代理身份→用戶確認→1Password 代填憑證；全程密碼不會接觸代理，每次存取需用戶明確批准。
相容主流代理平台：Claude Duet（Anthropic）、OpenAI Dots、ChatGPT Work、Grok Bot、Meta Muse，更多合作夥伴在洽談中；直接解決了「把密碼交給代理等於失控」的核心痛點。
美國銀行業已探測到代理在用戶帳戶內的活動，形容情況「令人震驚」，核心問題是銀行無法分辨代理行動是否獲用戶授權；1Password 方案處理憑證暴露問題，代理存取合規議題仍需行業共識。
highlights_en: Three-party loop: agent requests access → 1Password verifies agent identity → user approves → 1Password fills credentials. The agent never sees the password; every access event requires explicit user approval.
Compatible with Claude Duet, OpenAI Dots, ChatGPT Work, Grok Bot, and Meta Muse; directly addresses the 'handing passwords to agents means losing control' security gap.

U.S. banks are detecting agentic activity inside customer accounts and describe the situation as 'horrifying' — unable to distinguish user-authorized agent actions from unauthorized ones. 1Password resolves credential exposure but broader agentic access governance remains unsettled.

items.title: Google Demand Gen 十月更新：Data Manager 擴展至 DV360 與 GA，轉化量平均提升逾 20%
items.title_en: Google Demand Gen October Drop: Data Manager Expands to DV360 and GA, Avg. 20%+ Conversion Uplift
items.summary: Google Demand Gen 十月更新推出三項新功能：Data Strength Uplift 指標、Data Manager 擴展至 DV360 和 Google Analytics、以及增強轉化在 DV360/GA 的部署，使用 Google Tag Gateway 的廣告主平均轉化量提升逾 20%。
items.summary_en: Google's October Demand Gen drop adds three features: a Data Strength Uplift metric in the Google Ads UI, Data Manager expansion to DV360 and GA, and Enhanced Conversions coming to DV360/GA. Advertisers using Google Tag Gateway see 20%+ average conversion uplift.
items.why: Data Manager 擴展至 DV360 和 GA 意味著廣告主可在更多平台統一管理第一方數據，強化投標信號，今日就能開啟並驗證連接。
items.why_en: Data Manager expansion to DV360 and GA means consistent first-party data management across Google's full stack — activating this now improves bidding signals ahead of the holiday season.
highlights: 新增 Data Strength Uplift 指標，直接在 Google Ads 介面顯示數據配置帶來的轉化增量，無需跑自定義報告即可量化第一方數據的 ROI。
Data Manager 正式擴展至 Display & Video 360 及 Google Analytics，增強轉化（Enhanced Conversions）亦即將在 DV360/GA 推出，統一跨平台測量精度。
實測案例：保險比較平台 The Zebra 啟用 Google Tag Gateway 後轉化量升 16%、轉化總值升 19%；整體 Demand Gen 廣告主平均轉化提升逾 20%。
highlights_en: New Data Strength Uplift metric in the Google Ads UI quantifies conversion gains from your specific data configuration — no custom reporting needed to measure first-party data ROI.
Data Manager is expanding to Display & Video 360 and Google Analytics; Enhanced Conversions is coming to both, creating a unified measurement layer across Google's full ad stack.

Real-world result: insurance platform The Zebra saw 16% conversion volume growth and 19% conversion value growth after implementing Google Tag Gateway. Overall Demand Gen advertisers see 20%+ average conversion uplift.
